system.flavor: Argentine bullpup battle rifle, based on bullpup designs of the late 1990s. Good reliability, easily rechambered for other common round types.
system.notes:
Solo of Fortune p.42 (PDF idx 43) stat box (fresh tesseract OCR of the page graphic): RIF 2 N P 6.5 caseless (7.62Sov) 30 4 VR, $1400, 'Squad Auto has a ROF of 30.' SoF's review prose (p.41-43): 6.5x45mm caseless nicknamed 'El Lapiz', 30-round box, 3.7kg empty, no full auto - single shot or a four-round burst only.

Damage and range from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.28 (PDF idx 29), which prints it complete: RIF +2 N P 5D6+3 (6.5MM) 30 1/4 VR 400M, 1400eb. The heavy-barrel squad-automatic variant already ships as 'Fabrica de Armes M-2012HB SAW'.
